# Gabriele Somatic Coach

> Somatic, trauma-informed intimacy and sexuality coaching for analytical, high-achieving people who feel disconnected from their bodies, desire, or pleasure. Based in Berlin, working in person and online worldwide.

Gabriele is a Trained Somatica® Coach with a PhD in Physics and nearly two decades of experience as a tango dancer and teacher. The work helps people who "live in their heads" reconnect with their bodies, emotions, and authentic desire. The approach is grounded, consent-based, and trauma-informed.

## Who it is for

- Analytical, high-achieving people who feel cut off from their bodies or pleasure
- People carrying shame or conditioning around desire and intimacy
- People recovering from burnout who want to feel present and alive again

## What is offered

- Free 15-minute discovery call
- Single coaching sessions
- 5- and 10-session coaching journeys, with sliding-scale pricing
- Sessions in person in Berlin and online worldwide
